_meta.purpose: Single source of truth for the pairing_principles edge-label vocabulary. Read by train/train_v1.py (Path A) and train/dataset.py (Path B). If you change this file, both consumers must re-read it.

notes.n_canonical: 8 classes by default. If V1 still underperforms at the MEDIUM threshold and maillard-bridge has weak F1, set maillard_collapse_default=true (collapses maillard-bridge → shared-volatile) to drop to 7 classes. Both 7- and 8-class final vocabularies pass test_gates_v1.py.
notes.tradition: Catch-all. In Path B per N1-V3-ADR-4, tradition edges are dropped from the auxiliary classification loss but kept in topology (contrastive). In Path A V1, tradition is included normally — it'll likely be the worst-performing class (this is by design, not a bug).
notes.earthy_bridge_present_in_v3_data: yes, 8 occurrences in chef-saved CSV — must be collapsed before training
notes.herbal_bridge_present_in_v3_data: no — collapse rule kept for safety / future-proofing
notes.allium_bridge_present_in_v3_data: no — collapse rule kept for safety / future-proofing
